name: MBSF-MedPAR 65+ Dataset
description: MBSF-MedPAR 65+ contains linked CMS Medicare enrollment and inpatient claims products for beneficiaries age 65 and older. Products include beneficiary-year denominator records, inpatient admissions, and county/ZCTA aggregate files for hospitalization, mortality, and cohort summaries.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: manual
description: manual

name: MBSF-MedPAR 65+ Denominator File
description: Beneficiary-year denominator file for Medicare beneficiaries age 65 and older, linked to MedPAR inpatient claims and used for cohort construction and aggregate denominator counts.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted Beneficiary ID (CCW Encrypted Beneficiary ID Number)
content.year: Int64: Reference year of enrollment data (Reference Year from MBSF)
content.zcta: String: ZIP Code Tabulation Area mapped using https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/zip2zcta_master_xwalk
content.county: String: County FIPS code mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries
content.state: String: State code (SSA 2-digit) mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries and converted to state abbreviations
content.age_dob: Int64: Age calculated as year of data - year of birth (valid range: 65-115)
content.yob: Int64: Year of birth extracted from Date of Birth
content.sex: String: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.race: String: SSA Beneficiary Race Code (Base). Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: String: RTI-assigned enhanced race classification. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.hmo: Int32: HMO enrollment status. Code values: 1 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO), 0 = not enrolled.
content.hmo_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with HMO enrollment
content.hmo_indicators: List[String]: Monthly indicators of HMO (Medicare Advantage) enrollment (12-month indicators)
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status. Code values: 1 = dual eligible, 0 = not dual.
content.dual_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with dual eligibility; NULL if no monthly record exists
content.dual_indicators: List[String]: Monthly dual eligibility indicators (12 months)
content.buyin: Int32: Buy-in status for Medicare A/B. Code values: 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = none.
content.buyin_indicators: List[String]: Monthly Medicare A/B entitlement and buy-in status (12-month indicators)
content.buyin_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with state buy-in coverage
content.orec: Int32: Original reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = both DIB and ESRD.
content.curec: Int32: Current reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = both DIB and ESRD.
content.ffs_ind: Int32: Fee-for-Service eligibility indicator. Code values: 1 = Fee-for-Service eligible, 0 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO).
content.disability_ind: Int32: Disability entitlement indicator. Code values: 1 = disability entitlement, 0 = no disability entitlement.
content.age_65plus_ind: Int32: Age 65 or older indicator. Code values: 1 = age 65 or older, 0 = under age 65.

name: manual

name: MBSF-MedPAR 65+ Inpatient Claims
description: MedPAR inpatient stay file linked to MBSF enrollment records for Medicare beneficiaries age 65 and older. Records support hospitalization analyses within the 65-plus cohort.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted beneficiary identifier used to link MedPAR inpatient stays to MBSF denominator records
content.year: Int32: Calendar year of admission or source MedPAR file year
content.admission_year: Int64: Year of hospital admission derived from admission_date
content.adm_id: String: Admission identifier, unique per hospitalization record within the processed file
content.adm_day_of_week: Int32: Day of week of admission. Code values: 1 = Sunday, 2 = Monday, 3 = Tuesday, 4 = Wednesday, 5 = Thursday, 6 = Friday, 7 = Saturday. ResDAC reference: https://www.resdac.org/cms-data/files/medpar/data-documentation
content.ss_ls_snf_cd: String: Short-stay/long-stay/skilled nursing facility indicator code. Code values: S = Short-Stay, L = Long-Stay, N = SNF Stay. ResDAC reference: https://resdac.org/cms-data/variables/short-staylong-staysnf-provider-indicator-code
content.dschrgcd: String: MedPAR beneficiary discharge status code describing patient status at discharge. See ResDAC MedPAR data documentation for BENE_DSCHRG_STUS_CD: https://www.resdac.org/cms-data/files/medpar/data-documentation
content.dschrg_dstntn_cd: String: Discharge destination code. This code indicates the beneficiary destination after discharge and also captures death, SNF, and still-patient situations. Full code values are maintained by ResDAC: https://www.resdac.org/cms-data/variables/destination-upon-discharge-facility-code
content.admsn_type_cd: String: Inpatient admission type code. Code values: 0 = Unknown value present in data, 1 = Emergency, 2 = Urgent, 3 = Elective, 4 = Newborn, 5 = Trauma Center, 6-8 = Reserved, 9 = Unknown/information not available. ResDAC reference: https://www.resdac.org/cms-data/variables/inpatient-admission-type-code
content.src_admsn_cd: String: Source of inpatient admission code. This code indicates the source of admission or, for newborn admission, type of delivery. Full code values are maintained by ResDAC: https://www.resdac.org/cms-data/variables/source-admission-inpatient-facility-newborn-admit-type-delivery-code
content.primary_diagnosis: String: Principal diagnosis code for the inpatient stay. Diagnosis code metadata are described in the ResDAC MedPAR data documentation: https://www.resdac.org/cms-data/files/medpar/data-documentation
content.diagnoses: List[String]: Diagnosis codes recorded for the inpatient stay, including the primary diagnosis. Up to 9 diagnosis codes are available through 2009 and up to 25 from 2010 onward; ICD-10 diagnosis codes begin in October 2015. Diagnosis code metadata are described in the ResDAC MedPAR data documentation: https://www.resdac.org/cms-data/files/medpar/data-documentation
content.non_external_primary: Int32: Indicator that the principal diagnosis is a non-external-cause diagnosis
content.non_external_all: List[Int32]: Indicators for whether each diagnosis code is a non-external-cause diagnosis
content.los_day_cnt: Int32: Length of stay in days
content.drg_price_amt: Float64: Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) price amount
content.bene_blood_ddctbl_amt: Float64: Blood deductible amount paid by the beneficiary
content.bene_prmry_pyr_amt: Float64: Amount paid by the beneficiary primary payer or other insurance
content.bene_pta_coinsrnc_amt: Float64: Beneficiary Part A coinsurance amount

name: Daily County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Daily county-level stratified count file with beneficiary counts, deaths, and inpatient hospitalizations stratified by age, sex, race, RTI race/ethnicity, dual eligibility, HMO/Medicare Advantage status, buy-in status, and Fee-for-Service status. Sparse daily files include only dates and strata with recorded events.

content.date: Date32[day]: Calendar date for the sparse daily event counts
content.sex: String: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values follow MBSF/ResDAC coding: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.race: String: SSA beneficiary race code from CMS enrollment data. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: String: RTI enhanced race and ethnicity code. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.dual: Int32: Dual Medicare-Medicaid eligibility indicator; 1 = dual eligible in at least one month, 0 = not dual eligible
content.hmo: Int32: Medicare Advantage/HMO enrollment indicator; 1 = enrolled in HMO/Medicare Advantage, 0 = not enrolled
content.buyin: Int32: Medicare buy-in indicator; 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = no state buy-in months
content.ffs_ind: Int32: Fee-for-Service stratum indicator; 1 = hmo equals 0, 0 = enrolled in HMO/Medicare Advantage
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths for the given subgroup and date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of inpatient hospitalizations for the given subgroup and date
